title: Group Draw Not Yet Published by GAM3RS_X Prior to Finals Week
details: As of October 13, 2026, the specific group compositions (Group A vs Group B) and opening head-to-head fixtures have not been officially drawn/published by tournament organizer GAM3RS_X on HLTV or Liquipedia. Only the overall event dates (Oct 14-18, 2026) and 8-team qualified field are confirmed.
resolution: To enable complete Pick'em strategy and market line coverage regardless of which group pairings are revealed on media day (Oct 13), our origination model originates lines and win probabilities for all 28 possible pairwise combinations among the 8 qualified teams.

title: Absence of Pre-Match Sportsbook Fixed Odds Feeds (No Hotspawn Indicator)
details: Traditional retail sportsbooks (e.g. Bet365, Pinnacle, Thunderpick) have not posted published fixed match lines prior to the official group draw. Furthermore, per user requirements, Hotspawn's pick'em lobby cannot be used as an indicator of match probability.
resolution: Strict adherence to user requirement: We originate our own independent match lines for all 28 matchups and outrights, derived from official Valve Regional Standings (VRS) global ratings, HLTV team rankings, recent Tier-1 LAN form, and calibrated against historical CS2 prediction market orderbook dynamics.

title: Venue Wording Discrepancy Across Official & Secondary Sources
details: Thunderpick's official press releases state the event takes place at 'BLAST Studios Malta'. Liquipedia lists the venue as 'BLAST Arena Studios' in Attard, Malta. HLTV's news release references 'BLAST Arena studio'.
resolution: Confirmed to refer to the exact same physical production studio complex in Attard, Malta operated by BLAST for international esports LAN tournaments.

title: PARIVISION Roster Transition: slaxejezzz Benched, HObbit Signed Permanently
details: Valve's October 5, 2026 VRS standings list slaxejezzz on the 5-man PARIVISION roster. However, on September 17, 2026, PARIVISION officially announced slaxejezzz was benched and placed on loan, while Major Champion HObbit was signed permanently to the active lineup.
resolution: Flagged and verified. HObbit is recorded as the active starting member for the TWC 2026 Malta Finals, while slaxejezzz is cataloged in the bench register. Core roster requirements under Section 2.10/3.7 of the TWC rulebook are fully met (FL1T, Jame, xiELO maintain the 3-player core).

title: Contradictory Qualification Slot Phrasing in Official Qualifier Portal
details: The official Thunderpick World Championship Global Qualifier web portal contained conflicting text, stating in one section 'Four teams will earn a slot at the Malta Finals' and in another 'the winner of the Global Qualifier earns a spot at the $1M Finals'.
resolution: Confirmed from final standings: exactly ONE spot was awarded to the qualifier winner. Virtus.pro swept HOTU 3-0 in the Grand Final on Sep 13, 2026 and secured the 8th and final spot at the Malta LAN alongside the 7 VRS invitees.

title: EU Series 1 Winner Name Discrepancy (VRSDelivery vs DragonClaw)
details: Hotspawn's news recap from May 31, 2026 reports 'VRSDelivery win Thunderpick World Championship European Series 1'. However, HLTV's prize ledger lists 'DragonClaw' as the first-place winner.
resolution: Liquipedia transfer records confirm VRSDelivery was officially acquired and rebranded as DragonClaw on May 30, 2026—one day prior to winning the tournament final. Neither team reached the Malta Finals as regional winners only advanced to the qualifier.
